description: First Vee3 boot-interface adaptations for Linux 3.18. This is not a complete timer/platform port or a bootable kernel.

replacements.reason: Declare the direct timer initialization hook for the 3.18 machine descriptor; retain the legacy timer declaration for the 3.4 reference build.
The Vee3 is uniprocessor and does not use the removed ARM local-timer header.
Use the generic sched_clock interface provided by Linux 3.18.

replacements.after:
#if LINUX_VERSION_CODE >= KERNEL_VERSION(3, 18, 0)
static u64 notrace msm_read_sched_clock(void)
#else
static u32 notrace msm_read_sched_clock(void)
#endif
replacements.reason: sched_clock_register requires a u64-returning counter reader; the hardware counter width remains unchanged.
Register the existing MSM counter with the 3.18 generic scheduler clock without changing its frequency or effective counter width.
Allow the Vee3 machine descriptor to invoke the timer initializer directly.
Linux 3.18 no longer defines struct sys_timer; preserve it only for the 3.4 reference build.
Select the correct machine timer API for each kernel baseline.

replacements.before:
#ifdef CONFIG_MACH_MSM7X25A_V3
MACHINE_START(MSM7X25A_V3, "MSM7225A v3")
	.atag_offset	= 0x100,
	.map_io		= msm_common_io_init,
	.reserve	= msm7x27a_reserve,
	.init_irq	= msm_init_irq,
	.init_machine	= msm7x2x_init,
	.timer		= &msm_timer,
replacements.after:
#ifdef CONFIG_MACH_MSM7X25A_V3
MACHINE_START(MSM7X25A_V3, "MSM7225A v3")
	.atag_offset	= 0x100,
	.map_io		= msm_common_io_init,
	.reserve	= msm7x27a_reserve,
	.init_irq	= msm_init_irq,
	.init_machine	= msm7x2x_init,
#if LINUX_VERSION_CODE >= KERNEL_VERSION(3, 18, 0)
	.init_time	= msm_timer_init,
#else
	.timer		= &msm_timer,
#endif
replacements.reason: Use the 3.18 init_time hook only in the Vee3 descriptor. Other LG boards have not been ported or validated.
